name: African American
hair_notes: Mostly black or dark brown, with the odd bright dye job. Afros, high-top fades, short twists, cornrows, shoulder-length locs, bald fades. Full beards, goatees and thin mustaches all work.

name: East Asian
hair_notes: Mostly black or very dark brown, with the odd bright dye job. Straight hair: bowl cuts, spiky crops, center parts, curtain bangs, slicked back, long and tied back. Thin mustaches or clean-shaven.

name: Southeast Asian
hair_notes: Mostly black, straight or wavy, with the odd bright dye job. Layered mops, side-swept fringes, short crops, shoulder-length waves. Mostly clean-shaven, some thin mustaches.

name: Pacific Islander
hair_notes: Mostly black, thick, wavy or curly. Big curls, topknots, shaved sides with a long top, long waves. Full beards and goatees work.

name: Hispanic
hair_notes: Mostly black or dark brown, with the odd bright dye job. Slicked-back waves, pompadours, short fades, curly mops, long hair. Thick mustaches, goatees and short beards work.

name: Indian
hair_notes: Mostly black. Side parts, thick wavy hair, combed-back hair, puffed-up quiffs, curls. Thick mustaches and trimmed beards work.

name: Middle Eastern/North African
hair_notes: Mostly black or dark brown. Thick curls, short slicked hair, swept-back waves, receding hairlines. Full dark beards, stubble and thick mustaches work.

name: Native American/Indigenous
hair_notes: Mostly black. Long straight hair, two long braids, shoulder-length cuts, short crops. Mostly clean-shaven. No feathers, headdresses or face paint.
